text:
Maya (sec): Quick sync: planning a coordinated base-image rebake Wed 02:30 UTC to address the high-severity vuln sweep and remove a couple of legacy apt layers. Need RBAC binding, KMS signing approach, and audit-forwarding confirmed. Plan: produce signed artifacts under tag 'core-slim:v2026-03-24'.

Jon (eng-infra): Proposed RBAC: Role 'rebake-signer' in namespace 'ci' with secrets/get, secrets/use, and pods/exec (for signer runner). Bind to group 'build-runners'. I'll add an annotation `rbac.redwood.io/runner-pool: "rebake"` on the RoleBinding so only that pool can hit the key. Thoughts?

Tse (eng-runtime): FYI runtime will need KV prefix invalidation and ephemeral cache flush. We'll accept a rebuild header `X-Rebuild-Id: core-slim-20260324` on internal purge endpoint. Also request to keep previous signed keys in KMS for 72h as a fallback.

Priya (eng-sre): Preflight window: 01:30 UTC smoke, 02:10 UTC small canary rollout, 02:30 full cut. I'll run node drain/uncordon scripts and watch image pullbackoff. Post the artifact id here when the build is ready.

ArtifactBot: Build queue: core-rebake-2026-03-24T02:30Z queued id=cr-6021. Storage: gs://images/rebakes/cr-6021. Trigger: manual by Maya (sec).

Maya (sec): Two audit asks: 1) KMS audit logs must be forwarded to Splunk index 'security.kms' during the window, and 2) enable request-level logging for cosign operations (caller identity + key version) for 30d retention. Jon please confirm.

Jon (eng-infra): Can do. Quick decision point: HSM-backed key vs software KMS. HSM gives stronger non-exportability and attestation but cosign signing latency ~150ms higher per artifact. For prod I'd prefer HSM; for staging software KMS. We can do a blue/green: sign staging with software, verify, then promote prod with HSM.

Tse (eng-runtime): Agree. Also flag: some internal test runners still use musl-based tooling images which fail newer libc hooks. We should exclude images with label `runtime=musl` from this batch until the triage is complete. Add that to PR exclusions.

Priya (eng-sre): Checklist I'm going to run in preflight (posting status here):
- RBAC applied in 'ci' and binding validated (Jon)
- cosign sign/verify using kms:// path tested (Tse)
- cache invalidation endpoint accepts `X-Rebuild-Id` (Tse)
- rollback images still resolvable by image-tag (keep 3 older tags)
- runbook & rollback playbook linked to pager duty

Maya (sec): Policy note: please include annotation `security.audit/source: "rebake-2026-03-24"` on every signed artifact metadata so SOC can correlate KMS logs. Also include key-id and key-version in signing metadata.

Jon (eng-infra): RBAC pushed to staging: Role `rebake-signer-staging` and RoleBinding with `rbac.redwood.io/runner-pool: "rebake"`. I ran a smoke `kubectl auth can-i create secrets --as=system:serviceaccount:ci:rebake-runner` and it returned yes.

Tse (eng-runtime): cosign verify smoke passed against staging key: `cosign verify --key kms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/rebake/cryptoKeys/coreKey cr-6021` -> OK. Cache purge accepted: `curl -XPOST https://runtime.internal/purge -H 'X-Rebuild-Id: core-slim-20260324'` -> 202 accepted.

Priya (eng-sre): I'll perform the 01:30 preflight and report back here. Watchlist: image-pull-backoff, kubelet OOM, cosign verify failures, slow signing latency causing CI timeouts.

Maya (sec): Final call: proceed with staging run if preflight green. For prod: use HSM key and keep old software key active for 72h as fallback. Jon please ensure Splunk index 'security.kms' has an ingest rule for `proto:cosign` and retention 30d. If SOC has questions I'll add them to this thread. :white_check_mark:

Jon (eng-infra): Will attach short audit runbook and Splunk ingest rule in the PR. Also adding a small TTL on the RoleBinding (`rbac.redwood.io/ttl: "4h"`) so elevated signing privileges auto-expire after the window.

Priya (eng-sre): Preflight done at 01:30 UTC: RBAC validated, cosign sign/verify ok, cache purge ok. No regressions observed in canary. Proceeding to schedule full rollout at 02:30 UTC. Logs will be uploaded to /var/log/rebake/cr-6021/*. If anything goes wrong I'll trigger rollback tag `core-slim:rollback-20260324`.

Maya (sec): Thanks team. I'll file the compliance note and notify SOC. Leaving this thread open for any immediate post-cut issues.
